summary: First full test pass for Date Spark. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering /config/public, geocode, sparks generate/get/save/schedule/share/complete, /sparks/mine, /shared/{id}, /events, free limit enforcement (with X-Premium bypass), auth (signup+migrate, login, /me, duplicate email 409, wrong password 401, delete account invalidates token), admin stats+config, and non-admin 403. Frontend: full wizard flow Welcome -> Who -> Vibe -> Budget -> Distance+location -> results renders 3 spark cards, spark detail shows itinerary steps, map placeholder, save toast, Spark-It navigates to share screen with invitation card, date/time chips and both Share Spark + Copy Invitation buttons. Profile: guest -> Log In as admin@datespark.app renders Admin dashboard link -> /admin shows stats grid and config form. Google Places disabled upstream so sparks return needs_verification=true which the UI shows as 'Some venue details need verification' (expected). RevenueCat missing web API keys logs a warning (expected on web).

issues: popular_relationships shows both 'partner' (from wizard key) and 'Partner' (capitalized) as separate rows because analytics aggregation is case-sensitive. Consider normalizing relationship_type case before storing/aggregating.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Affects react-native-web output. Not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Normalize relationship_type casing in analytics_events.props so /admin/stats popular_relationships doesn't duplicate 'partner' / 'Partner'.
(Optional) Migrate remaining `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` to silence RN-Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~650 lines and stays readable but is approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting sparks/admin/auth into modules if it grows further.

usage_for() counts documents by event=sparks_generated across the month; the returned `usage.used += 1` in generate() is only in-memory for the response and is fine, but be aware it can drift if two generations happen concurrently before the analytics insert commits.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: signup tests create users then soft-delete them; free-limit test flips free_spark_limit to 0 then restores to 3. UI run created a few guest sparks (they live under a random X-Guest-ID and do not affect prod data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env (https://vibe-finder-75.preview.emergentagent.com). LLM generation takes ~20-40s; use timeout=120 for /api/sparks/generate. Google Places is disabled upstream, so sparks return needs_verification=true and venue=null (expected). On web, RevenueCat has no keys -- do NOT attempt a purchase test. OptionCard aria-selected is not exposed on Pressable in RN-Web so use screen navigation (waiting for next testID) as the assertion for selection, not aria-selected.
